unit_portion:
A rendered report stated that a set of items showed 'coordinated rather than independent operation.' Neither half of that reading survives inspection: the uniformity it rests on comes from a shared configuration constant rather than from the items, and the links that made the set look mutually corroborating connect co-authored slices of a single underlying fact.

Two independent mechanisms arrive at the same read site. First, the position a given seat is assigned depends on an authored role label, and each role label maps to a fixed numeric constant. Two of the five constants, 0.12 and 0.25, sit on opposite sides of the sign root of the curve the verdict is computed from — the root falls at about 0.164 — and they are each other's nearest alternative. So a seat whose author picked either of those two roles has a verdict that flips outright if the author had picked the other. In the live data 101 of the seats carry one of them and 2 carry the other: 103 of 105 comparable seats, 98%, are in this state. Uniformity across such items therefore reports which role most authors reached for, not anything measured about the situations. Second, the link structure feeding the same read joins any two items that share a beneficiary or share a victim, and has no notion of node independence at all — three slices of one fact form a complete triangle that is indistinguishable in kind from a triangle of genuinely distinct items. A deduplication step compounds this by collapsing a pair's two links into one label, so 'these two share both sides' cannot even be expressed at that layer. The read site above them then treats the triangle as three corroborating observations, when it is one observation described three times.

Criteria fixed and committed before any run, with each outcome's meaning written down in advance. For the link structure, a synthetic fixture of six items: three co-authored slices of one fact with matched parties and near-identical magnitudes, and three pairwise-distinct extractive items. The first three formed the complete triangle and the second three formed no links at all — which makes the first group the positive control for the second, so the empty lists are a filter result rather than a probe that never ran. The fixture's magnitudes were chosen to sit safely inside the margin rather than on it, because a value on the boundary would have passed on rounding alone. For the seat verdicts, a census over the live output computed the sign root from the serialized parameters of that same output rather than from a copied constant, pasted all five role constants because the nearest-alternative claim depends on every one of them, and reported every bucket separately — including the seats whose value matches no role constant and the seats with no value at all, which shrink the denominator and are counted rather than quietly dropped.

A published report asserted coordination among items where the shared property was a configuration constant. The repair is at the read sites rather than the constants: an independence column and a legend that names a link between items sharing both a beneficiary and a victim at near-identical magnitude as re-description rather than corroboration; a mark on any seat verdict that flips under a single authored role change; and a replacement for the coordination sentence that names both alternative explanations. One pre-registered detail was extended during implementation rather than followed literally: the census turned up a firing of the same predicate at a seat the design had not scoped, and suppressing it would have unflagged a witnessed firing, so the flag is computed per seat.
payload:
You will read one description of a software failure and assign it exactly one category.

Here are the five categories, plus a sixth for incidents that fit none of them. All six are equally
available answers. Each category is given in its original wording followed by an English rendering.

A — 环境/平台 Quirk  (environment / platform quirk)
逻辑正确，运行环境隐含行为导致失效（dev 绿灯，target 暴露）。
系统逻辑正确，但运行环境（OS / shell / 客户端 / 文件系统）的隐含行为导致意外。
*The logic is correct, but implicit behaviour of the runtime environment — operating system, shell,
client, filesystem — causes it to fail. Characteristically: the development environment is always
green, and only running on the real target exposes it.*

B — 设计假设错配  (design-assumption mismatch)
代码假设 vs 实际（部署拓扑 / 契约 / 测试形态 / 涌现行为）。
代码基于某个假设，但假设与实际不一致。
*The code rests on an assumption — about deployment topology, a cross-component contract, the shape
of test input, or emergent behaviour — and the assumption does not match reality. Characteristically:
unit tests covering the logic correctly is not the same as covering the real caller's actual form.*

C — 错误吞噬与稀释  (error swallowing and dilution)
错误发生但被某层静默吃掉 / 跨层稀释失 cause / 自动批量放大。
错误真实发生了，但被某一层静默吃掉，或跨层传递时上游 cause 被稀释，最终用户视角看到的是"成功"或
一个失去信息的告警。
*The error really happened, but some layer silently ate it, or the upstream cause was diluted while
being passed across layers, so what the end user finally sees is "success" or an alert that has lost
its information.*

D — 链式幻觉与编造  (chained hallucination and fabrication)
把污染数据当事实，编造合理叙事推送给用户（最危险）。
错误不是消失，而是被加工成看起来正常的内容。链路中每一跳都会放大幻觉，前一跳的幻觉会被下游当作
事实执行。
*Corrupted data or polluted context is taken as fact and worked up into a plausible narrative that
is pushed to the user. The error does not disappear — it is processed into content that looks
normal. Each hop amplifies it, and one hop's fabrication is executed downstream as fact.*

E — 运维遗漏与取证盲区  (operational omission and forensic blind spot)
代码正确但部署/注册步骤遗漏 / 调试工具自身被屏蔽长潜伏。
两个子机制：(1) 运维遗漏 — 代码正确但部署/注册/配置步骤被漏（声明态 ≠ 运行时态）；
(2) 取证盲区 — 调试工具自身被屏蔽返回空内容，被误读为"正常"，导致超长潜伏。
*Two sub-mechanisms: (1) operational omission — the code is correct but a deployment, registration
or configuration step was missed, so declared state is not runtime state; (2) forensic blind spot —
the debugging tool is itself blocked and returns empty content, which is misread as "normal",
producing an extremely long latency before discovery.*

other — 机制不属于以上任何一类。
*The incident's mechanism is not one of the five above. This is a substantive answer, not a
leftover. Choose it whenever the mechanism described is genuinely a different kind of thing,
including when the description is too thin to identify a mechanism at all.*

---
